title: MFD-11.5 Morphological Annotation Schema
description: Schema for Quranic Arabic morphological analysis entries. Computational suggestions are distinguished from human-verified results via analysisMethod and reviewStatus fields.

surfaceForm.description: Arabic surface form as it appears in the Quranic text (with diacritics)

transliteration.description: Romanized transliteration of the surface form

lemma.description: Arabic lemma (dictionary/citation form). null = insufficient evidence to assign

root.description: Triliteral or quadriliteral root in hyphenated form (e.g., 'ع-ب-د')

rootConfidence.description: Confidence in root assignment from prior analysis

morphForm.description: Verb form designation (e.g., 'Form I', 'Form II', 'Form X') or noun category (e.g., 'masdar', 'active participle', 'passive participle', 'noun of place', 'noun of instrument'). null if undetermined.

pattern.description: Morphological pattern template (e.g., 'faʿala', 'faʿʿala', 'fāʿala', 'afʿala', 'tafaʿʿala', 'tafāʿala', 'infaʿala', 'iftaʿala', 'ifʿalla', 'istafʿala', 'faʿl', 'faʿil', 'faʿīl', 'fuʿl', 'mafʿūl', 'mifʿāl', 'tafʿīl', 'istifʿāl'). null if undetermined.

gender.description: Grammatical gender. null if not applicable or undetermined.

number.description: Grammatical number. null if not applicable or undetermined.

person.description: Grammatical person (verbs only). null for nouns/particles.

caseOrMood.description: Case for nouns/adjectives (nominative, accusative, genitive) or mood for verbs (indicative, subjunctive, jussive, imperative). null if undetermined.

weakRoot.description: Contains hamza, waw, ya, or alif as root radical

alternativeAnalyses.description: List of alternative morphological analyses when form is ambiguous

analysisMethod.description: How this analysis was derived. 'corpus-cross-reference' = matched against includedLemmas/occurrences in data/root-occurrences/. 'computational' = pattern-based inference without corpus match. 'manual' = human scholar verified. 'mixed' = computational suggestion with partial corpus support.

confidence.description: Overall confidence in this analysis. 'disputed' = multiple valid analyses exist and scholarly consensus is needed.

reviewStatus.description: Current review state. All computational outputs start as 'pending-scholarly-review'. Only human verification changes this.

sourceReferences.description: References to source files or ayah locations supporting this analysis

originalGloss.description: Editorial gloss from the original morphology index

grammaticalNotes.description: Any grammatical notes carried forward from prior analysis
